analyzed_vuln.description: `dissect_rtps` stores packet-scope (`wmem_packet_scope`) allocations (`key` via `wmem_strdup` and `guid_copy` via `wmem_memdup`) into `pinfo->private_table`, which is created with `g_hash_table_new_full(..., g_free, g_free)`. GLib then frees those entries with `g_free` during hash-table updates/destruction, but packet-scope cleanup later frees the same pointers again in `wmem_simple_free_all`, causing a double-free. Root cause is allocator/lifetime mismatch: packet-scope-owned memory is handed to a container that assumes ownership and frees with `g_free`.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger requires RTPS dissection path where `pinfo->private_table != NULL` (or is created for TCP) and insertion at `dissect_rtps` line around 11935 executes. The crafted packet reaches RTPS over TCP heuristic path; `g_hash_table_insert` frees/replaces an existing entry (or later table destruction frees entries) using `g_free` on pointers allocated from `wmem_packet_scope`. At end of packet processing, `wmem_leave_packet_scope` calls `wmem_simple_free_all`, re-freeing the same allocation and crashing with ASan double-free.
